title: Double-plane iris: a 14 × 6 mm window, 2 mm thick, centred in WR-90, at 10 GHz
source: Mode matching of the vector TE_mn and TM_mn modes at each junction (the field on the junction's plane on the two apertures' intersection), cascaded as generalised scattering matrices (H.
